concept_en: What It Means to Control a Line
question_cn: 「控制开放线路」对车和象的意义分别是什么？
question_en: What does controlling an open line mean for rooks and bishops, respectively?

options.text_cn: 车控制开放纵线（无兵阻挡的列），象控制开放斜线（无兵阻挡的对角线）；两者获得更大的活动范围和攻击力
options.text_en: Rooks use open files and bishops use open diagonals; both gain greater range and attacking power.

options.text_cn: 车只能控制横线，象只能控制纵线
options.text_en: Rooks control ranks only, while bishops control files only.

options.text_cn: 线路对象没有影响，只对车有意义
options.text_en: Lines do not matter to bishops; they are relevant only to rooks.

options.text_cn: 只要有棋子在线路上就叫控制，无论是否有兵阻挡
options.text_en: A line is controlled whenever a piece occupies it, even if pawns block it.

explanation_cn: 车在开放纵线（该列无己方兵或对方兵阻挡）上可以直接贯穿棋盘，威力大增。象在开放斜线上同理——没有兵阻挡的对角线让象的射程延伸到对方阵地。控制线路的核心是「清除障碍，让棋子充分发挥射程」。
explanation_en: A rook on an open file, with no pawns blocking it, can exert influence across the board. Likewise, an unblocked diagonal lets a bishop reach deep into the opponent's position. The key is to clear obstacles so the pieces can use their full range.
